title: The expert’s edge? Bank lending specialization and informational advantages for credit risk assessment
title_zh: 专家优势？银行贷款专业化与信用风险评估中的信息优势
title_primary: 专家优势？银行贷款专业化与信用风险评估中的信息优势

authors: Mathieu Simoens, Fabio Tamburrini
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine whether sectoral specialization provides informational advantages to banks, enabling better credit risk assessment of their outstanding corporate loan exposures. Using euro area credit register data, we compare probabilities of default assigned by more and less specialized banks to the same borrowing firm several quarters before the borrower defaults. We find that banks specialized in the borrower’s sector are better at predicting future defaults in their lending portfolios, which is reflected in specialized banks actively raising probabilities of default earlier, suggesting informational advantages over the lifetime of the loans. More specialized banks also increase loan loss provisions to these borrowers more quickly and are more likely to implement forbearance measures. We find no evidence of similar effects towards healthy borrowers, suggesting that our findings are not attributable to general conservatism but to more accurate evaluation of credit risk in the sectors of banks’ specialization. We show that our results are primarily driven by the smallest firms, and that the informational advantages of specialization are stronger when banks do not have long-term relationships with their borrowers and when they are confronted with a sectoral wave of defaults.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了行业专业化是否能为银行提供信息优势，使其能够更准确地评估未偿还企业贷款敞口的信用风险。利用欧元区信贷登记数据，我们在借款人违约前几个季度，比较了专业化程度较高与较低的银行对同一借款企业所设定的违约概率。我们发现，专注于借款人所在行业的银行更能预测其贷款组合中的未来违约情况，这体现在专业化银行更早地主动上调违约概率，表明其在贷款存续期内具有信息优势。更为专业化的银行还会更快地增加对这些借款人的贷款损失准备金，并且更可能实施宽容措施。我们未发现对健康借款人类似效应的证据，这表明我们的发现并非源于普遍的保守主义，而是源于银行在其专业化行业内对信用风险更准确的评估。我们证明，我们的结果主要由最小型企业驱动，并且当银行与借款人缺乏长期关系以及面临行业性违约浪潮时，专业化的信息优势更为显著。

title: Money and Social Exclusion in Networks
title_zh: 网络中的货币与社会排斥

title_secondary: Money and Social Exclusion in Networks
authors: Maria Bigoni, Gabriele Camera, Edoardo Gallo
official: 官方在线 2025-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Globalization offers unparalleled opportunities to expand welfare through cooperation across large networks of unrelated individuals. Social exclusion – permanent or temporary – and monetary exchange are institutions that in theory can incentivize cooperation. In an experiment, we evaluate their relative performance and interaction in anonymous networks of different sizes. Permanent social exclusion (ostracism) reduces long-run economic potential by leading to sparse networks. Monetary exchange and temporary social exclusion perform similarly well in small networks. In large networks, however, monetary exchange is the only institution that promotes full cooperation by crowding out ostracism and keeping the network complete. An insight is that monetary systems outperform social exclusion mechanisms in promoting cooperation in globalized social and economic networks.
abstract_zh: 全球化通过跨越大量无亲缘关系个体的广泛网络合作，为扩展福利提供了前所未有的机遇。社会排斥——无论是永久性的还是暂时性的——以及货币交换，在理论上都是能够激励合作的制度。在一项实验中，我们评估了它们在不同规模匿名网络中的相对表现及其相互作用。永久性社会排斥（放逐）通过导致网络稀疏化，削弱了长期经济潜力。在小规模网络中，货币交换与暂时性社会排斥表现相当。然而，在大规模网络中，货币交换是唯一能通过挤出放逐行为并保持网络完整性来促进全面合作的制度。一个洞见是，在全球化社会与经济网络中，货币体系在促进合作方面优于社会排斥机制。

official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We measure how workers use genAI for their jobs in a nationally representative survey. Our data provide the first task-level genAI adoption indexes, which can inform analyses of genAI's labor market impact. Exposure scores explain some, but far from all, of the variation in adoption across occupations and tasks. Chat-log measures differ conceptually and tend to over-classify chats into generic activities. Current adoption is widespread but shallow: genAI is used across many occupations and tasks, yet within most, fewer than half of workers adopt. Understanding who adopts may thus matter as much as understanding which tasks genAI assists.
abstract_zh: 我们在全国代表性调查中衡量了工人如何在工作中使用生成式人工智能。我们的数据提供了首个任务层面的生成式人工智能采用指数，可为分析生成式人工智能对劳动力市场的影响提供信息。暴露度评分解释了职业和任务间采用差异的一部分，但远非全部。聊天记录指标在概念上有所不同，且倾向于将聊天过度归类为一般性活动。当前采用情况广泛但浅层：生成式人工智能应用于众多职业和任务，但在大多数领域内，采用者不足半数。因此，理解谁在采用可能与分析生成式人工智能辅助哪些任务同样重要。

abstract: We examine the impact of climate risk exposure on corporate resilience using data on Chinese A-share listed firms. The results show that higher climate-related disclosure intensity is significantly negatively associated with corporate resilience, with a stronger association among firms whose executives lack environmental backgrounds, as well as firms in high-carbon and heavily polluting industries. Further analysis indicates that greenwashing exacerbates this negative effect, whereas green investment effectively mitigates the adverse impact of climate risk on corporate resilience. Mechanism tests show that climate risk mainly undermines firms’ adaptive capacity by intensifying external monitoring and suppressing risk-taking. Overall, this article provides new disclosure-based evidence on the relationship between climate risk and corporate resilience. abstract_zh: 我们利用中国A股上市公司的数据，考察了气候风险暴露对企业韧性的影响。结果显示，气候相关披露强度越高，企业韧性显著越低，且这一关联在管理层缺乏环境背景的企业以及高碳、重污染行业的企业中更为明显。进一步分析表明，绿色洗白行为加剧了这一负面效应，而绿色投资则能有效缓解气候风险对企业韧性的不利影响。机制检验显示，气候风险主要通过加强外部监督和抑制风险承担来削弱企业的适应能力。总体而言，本文为气候风险与企业韧性之间的关系提供了基于披露的新证据。关键词：气候风险；企业韧性；外部监督；风险规避；文本分析 JEL分类：Q54 L25 G32 D22

authors: Weike Zhang, Qinmei Zheng, Ming Zeng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In the context of a rapidly ageing population, the escalating costs of elderly care pose significant challenges for households in allocating investment assets, thereby impeding optimal asset distribution. Drawing on data from the China Household Finance Survey (CHFS) spanning 2011 to 2019, this study takes the pilot of the long-term care insurance policy (LTCI policy) as a quasi-natural experiment to empirically examine how it reshapes Chinese household financial asset allocation. The findings indicate that the LTCI policy increases the share of investment assets held by households by 2.50 percentage points. The main findings remain robust to a series of robustness checks, including the Sun-Abraham event-study approach and the de Chaisemartin and D’Haultfœuille framework for addressing treatment-effect heterogeneity. Policy beneficiary analyses reveal that LTCI has significant effects among households in central and western China, urban households, risk-averse households, households with limited financial literacy, and households with low social capital. The results further show that LTCI is positively associated with household income and negatively associated with household debt, providing suggestive evidence consistent with potential income- and debt-related pathways.

title: How labor market competition shapes workplace information on social media: evidence from Glassdoor reviews

authors: Shuo Li, Rencheng Wang, Liandong Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how labor market competition affects the quality of workplace information on social media. Using employer reviews on Glassdoor for U.S. publicly listed firms from 2011 to 2022, we find that reviews become less informative about actual workplace practices when firms face more intense competition for labor, consistent with competition inducing workplace information management. The decline in review informativeness is more pronounced when employees have narrower external networks, when firms are less unionized, and when firms have a smaller review base, suggesting that workplace information management is more likely when labor market information asymmetry is greater. Additional analyses show that positive reviews in highly competitive labor markets predict higher short-term labor inflows but greater subsequent employee turnover, indicating a gap between managed expectations and actual workplace conditions. Taken together, our evidence suggests that labor market competition potentially distorts the crowdsourced signals available to job seekers on anonymous review websites.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了劳动力市场竞争如何影响社交媒体上职场信息的质量。利用2011年至2022年间美国上市公司在Glassdoor上的雇主评价，我们发现当企业面临更激烈的劳动力竞争时，评价对实际工作场所实践的反映程度降低，这与竞争诱发职场信息管理现象相符。评价信息量的下降在员工外部网络较窄、企业工会化程度较低以及企业评价基数较小的情况下更为显著，这表明当劳动力市场信息不对称程度更高时，职场信息管理更易发生。进一步分析显示，在高度竞争的劳动力市场中，正面评价能预测短期劳动力流入的增加，但随后员工离职率也更高，揭示了管理预期与实际工作条件之间的差距。综合来看，我们的证据表明，劳动力市场竞争可能扭曲了匿名评价网站上求职者可获得的众包信号。

title_secondary: Faith and Assimilation: Italian Immigrants in the US
authors: Stefano Gagliarducci, Marco Tabellini
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2022-05-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How do ethnic religious organizations influence immigrants’ assimilation in host societies? This paper offers the first systematic answer to this question by focusing on Italian Catholic churches in the US between 1890 and 1920, when four million Italians moved to America, and anti-Catholic sentiments were widespread. Relying on newly collected data on the presence of Italian Catholic churches across counties over time, we implement a difference-in-differences design. We find that Italian churches reduced the social assimilation of Italian immigrants, lowering intermarriage, residential integration, and naturalization rates. We provide evidence that stronger coordination within the Italian community and natives' backlash and negative stereotyping can explain these effects. Despite the negative effects on Italians' social assimilation, Italian churches had ambiguous effects on immigrants' economic outcomes, and increased children's literacy and ability to speak English.
abstract_zh: 种族宗教组织如何影响移民在宿主社会中的同化？本文通过聚焦1890年至1920年间美国的意大利天主教会，首次系统回答了这一问题，彼时四百万意大利人移居美国，且反天主教情绪普遍存在。基于我们新收集的关于各县意大利天主教会随时间分布的数据，我们采用了双重差分设计。研究发现，意大利教会降低了意大利移民的社会同化程度，减少了跨族通婚、居住融合及入籍率。我们提供的证据表明，意大利社区内部更强的协调性以及本土居民的反弹和负面刻板印象可以解释这些效应。尽管对意大利移民的社会同化产生了负面影响，意大利教会对移民的经济成果影响尚不明确，但提高了儿童的识字率和英语口语能力。

title: The Value of Controlling Wilding Conifers in New Zealand
title_zh: 控制新西兰野生针叶树的价值
title_primary: 控制新西兰野生针叶树的价值
title_secondary: The Value of Controlling Wilding Conifers in New Zealand
authors: Maksym Polyakov, Abbie Rogers, Philip Stahlmann‐Brown, Rowan Sprague, Olivia Burge 等
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Exotic, invasive conifer tree species, known as ‘wilding conifers’, pose a significant threat to natural ecosystems and are costly to manage, creating a need to identify community preferences in order to inform and balance public investment in their control. Currently, approximately 7% of New Zealand's total land area is covered by invasive wilding conifers, and the rate of spread is approximately 5% per year. This study analysed the preferences of the New Zealand population regarding the control of wilding conifers in indigenous ecosystems using a choice experiment. The results, obtained through a mixed logistic model in willingness‐to‐pay space, showed that the public places significant value on controlling the spread of wilding conifers. Preferences for control displayed distance decay and diminishing marginal utility. The study also examined the spatial heterogeneity of preferences in terms of distance decay and the spatial dimension of scope. Finally, the study estimated the value of controlling the spread of wilding conifers nationally, which was found to be about NZ$147 million annually, and broadly consistent with the economic damage caused by other major invasive weeds in New Zealand. These findings confirm the importance of spatial factors in explaining preferences for the control of invasive trees and demonstrate how policymakers can use the estimated values to measure the benefits of different control options.
abstract_zh: 外来入侵性针叶树种，即所谓的“野生针叶树”，对自然生态系统构成重大威胁，且管理成本高昂，因此有必要识别社区偏好，以指导并平衡对其控制措施的公共投资。目前，新西兰约7%的国土面积被入侵性野生针叶树覆盖，且扩散速度约为每年5%。本研究采用选择实验法，分析了新西兰民众对控制本土生态系统中野生针叶树的偏好。通过支付意愿空间中的混合逻辑模型所得结果显示，公众对控制野生针叶树扩散赋予了显著价值。控制偏好表现出距离衰减和边际效用递减的特征。研究还考察了偏好的空间异质性，涉及距离衰减和范围的空间维度。最后，研究估算了全国范围内控制野生针叶树扩散的价值，发现约为每年1.47亿新西兰元，与新西兰其他主要入侵杂草造成的经济损失大致相符。这些发现证实了空间因素在解释对入侵树木控制偏好中的重要性，并展示了政策制定者如何利用估算价值来衡量不同控制方案的收益。

title: COVID-19 pandemic and prosociality: an experiment with healthcare professionals

official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the extent to which exposure to COVID-19 relates to healthcare professionals’ prosociality. Drawing on empirical evidence from an incentivized experiment and a companion survey of healthcare professionals (HCPs) at a large Italian hospital (N = 194), we find that different forms of exposure to COVID-19 predict their altruistic motivation in heterogeneous ways. HCPs who worked in COVID 19 wards or had a close relative or friend severely affected by the virus are more than 5 percentage points more likely to prioritize patient welfare over personal gain, with the association for professional exposure being mostly driven by female HCPs, especially nurses. Conversely, personally contracting COVID-19 is associated with a 6 percentage point decline in prosociality. Our results highlight that different experiences of need shape prosocial behavior in hospital settings.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了接触COVID-19与医护人员亲社会性之间的关联程度。基于一项激励性实验及对意大利一家大型医院医护人员（N=194）的配套调查所获得的实证证据，我们发现，不同形式的COVID-19暴露对其利他动机的预测作用存在异质性。在COVID-19病房工作或近亲或好友严重感染该病毒的医护人员，将患者福祉置于个人利益之上的可能性高出5个百分点以上，其中职业暴露的关联主要由女性医护人员，尤其是护士驱动。相反，个人感染COVID-19与亲社会性下降6个百分点相关。我们的结果凸显了不同需求经历如何塑造医院环境中的亲社会行为。

authors: Dickstein, Michael J., Jeon, Jihye, Morales, Eduardo
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Health plans in the U.S. increasingly use cost-sharing to steer demand for prescription drugs. However, the effectiveness of these incentives depends both on physicians’ price sensitivity and their knowledge of patient costs. We employ a moment inequality model to identify physician preferences without fully specifying their information. Applying this model to diabetes care, we find that physicians generally lack detailed price information and are more price sensitive than full-information models imply. We also identify substantial heterogeneity in preferences and information by physician training, suggesting a benefit from targeted information interventions.
abstract_zh: 美国健康计划日益采用费用分摊机制来引导处方药需求。然而，这些激励措施的有效性既取决于医生的价格敏感度，也取决于他们对患者成本的了解程度。我们运用矩不等式模型来识别医生偏好，无需完全设定其信息结构。将该模型应用于糖尿病护理领域，我们发现医生普遍缺乏详细的价格信息，且其价格敏感度高于完全信息模型所暗示的水平。我们还识别出医生培训背景导致的偏好和信息方面的显著异质性，这表明有针对性的信息干预措施可能带来益处。

title: Myths, Morals, and Movies

title_primary: 神话、道德与电影
title_secondary: Myths, Morals, and Movies
authors: Michalopoulos, Stelios, Rauh, Christopher
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Why are certain movies more successful in some markets than others? Are the entertainment products we consume reflective of our core beliefs? To answer these questions, we analyze international movie data and local tales using machine learning to measure a plot’s similarity to traditional motifs. Globally, films mirroring local folklore get wider screenings and earn more. Across US markets, movies matching ancestral stories attract more interest. Finally, films endorsing risk-taking, vengeance-seeking, and traditional gender roles outperform across markets holding similar historical and contemporary norms. Choosing to watch modern adaptations of stories passed down from our ancestors on the big screen reinforces cultural identity.
abstract_zh: 为何某些电影在特定市场更为成功？我们所消费的娱乐产品是否映射了我们的核心价值观？为解答这些问题，我们运用机器学习分析国际电影数据与地方传说，衡量剧情与传统母题的相似度。全球范围内，反映当地民间故事的电影获得更广泛的放映并取得更高票房。在美国各市场，与祖先故事相契合的电影更能吸引观众兴趣。最后，那些推崇冒险精神、复仇心理及传统性别角色的电影，在拥有相似历史与当代规范的市场中表现更佳。选择在大银幕上观看祖先流传下来的故事的现代改编，强化了文化认同。

abstract: There is a large body of evidence showing that for many countries the structure of wages and pensions and the labor law legislation are different for public and private employees. Such differences affect the occupational choice of agents and might generate some type of misallocation. We develop a life-cycle model with endogenous occupational choice and heterogeneous agents to study the implications of an overpaid public sector. The model is estimated to be consistent with micro and macro evidence for Brazil, a country with a high public sector earnings premium. Our counterfactual exercises demonstrate that public-private earnings premium can generate important allocation effects and sizeable productivity losses. For instance, a reform that would decrease the public-private wage premium from its benchmark value of $19\%$ to $15\%$ and would align the pension of public sector workers with the one in place for private sector workers could increase aggregate output by $11.2\%$ in the long-run without any decrease in the supply of public infrastructure. We provide a decomposition of the aggregate effect into changes in factors accumulation and changes in TFP and implement a welfare distributive analysis.
abstract_zh: 大量证据表明，在许多国家，公共部门与私营部门员工的工资结构、养老金制度及劳动法规存在差异。这些差异影响个体的职业选择，并可能引发某种形式的资源配置不当。我们构建了一个包含内生职业选择与异质性主体的生命周期模型，以研究公共部门薪酬过高所带来的影响。该模型基于巴西的微观与宏观证据进行校准，巴西是一个公共部门收入溢价较高的国家。我们的反事实实验表明，公共与私营部门间的收入溢价能产生重要的配置效应及显著的生产率损失。例如，一项改革若将公共与私营部门的工资溢价从基准值的19%降至15%，并使公共部门员工的养老金与私营部门员工保持一致，长期内可使总产出增加11.2%，且不减少公共基础设施的供给。我们将总体效应分解为要素积累变化与全要素生产率变化两部分，并进行福利分配分析。

abstract: Timely high school completion is a critical step in successful transitions to post-secondary schooling and the labor market. This randomized controlled trial, deployed in two urban, disadvantaged school districts, tests the effectiveness of a mature and comprehensive student-support program on an unusually large scale (n=2,528). While overall effects on graduation rates are small and statistically insignificant, exploratory analyses reveal notable variation by site and over time, mirroring heterogeneity in treatment timing and program implementation. abstract: This paper studies the environmental effects of the large-scale deployment of AI-driven monitoring systems across French wastewater treatment plants operated by a global leader in water supply services. Exploiting quasi-experimental variation in both the timing of adoption and outages thanks to high-frequency data, we estimate the causal impact of AI on energy use and carbon emissions. We find that AI has allowed treated plants to reduce their electricity consumption and carbon emissions by 5.4% and 6% respectively, and electricity costs by 8.2%, resulting in negative abatement costs, and still improved water effluent quality. The additional electricity demand generated by AI servers represents less than 1% of these savings. Beyond average effects, AI-equipped plants exhibit greater resilience to high operational stress, including extreme meteorological events and chemical pollutant peaks. They also improve load management by reallocating consumption from peak toward off-peak hours. Finally, we assess the aggregate implications of our findings for global climate and welfare using the DICE model. We find large estimated global welfare gains associated with our estimate of AI-induced CO2 reductions.

title_primary: 变革洪水韧性：面向适应性与再生性城市设计的以人为本人工智能

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban flooding poses escalating risks under climate change, requiring planning approaches that integrate technological precision with human and ecological values. This study introduces a Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence (HCAI) framework for adaptive and regenerative flood-resilient urban design. Unlike conventional AI approaches focused on optimisation, HCAI embeds ethical, participatory, and context-sensitive principles into land-use governance. The paper develops a four-pillar analytical framework – technical integration, institutional arrangements, stakeholder engagement, and land-use innovation – operationalised through a document-based comparative analysis of nine cities representing diverse flood typologies, governance regimes, and documented AI/digital flood-resilience activity. Documentary evidence suggests that AI tools such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Graph Neural Networks are reported to support flood-risk prediction and response coordination in flood-risk applications, while their planning relevance depends on inclusive decision-making and regenerative land-use strategies. Cities with stronger institutional embedding of AI-enabled or digital tools within adaptive regulatory systems and participatory platforms (e.g., Rotterdam, Copenhagen, Bangkok) show clearer planning-policy pathways, whereas those relying on fragmented or project-based deployments (e.g., Venice, Sydney) show limited continuity. Findings suggest that technical capability alone is insufficient: planning relevance depends on governance maturity, ethical safeguards, civic legitimacy, and linkage to spatial planning instruments. By coupling algorithmic intelligence with participatory and regulatory innovation, the study advances a policy-oriented framework for embedding HCAI into spatial governance and identifying conditions that may support a shift from defensive flood control toward regenerative, socially just urbanism. The framework guides AI institutionalisation within land-use systems and contributes to debates on equitable, data-driven climate adaptation.
abstract_zh: 气候变化背景下，城市洪涝风险持续加剧，亟需融合技术精度与人文生态价值的规划路径。本研究提出以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）框架，用于适应性、再生性防洪韧性城市设计。与侧重优化的传统AI方法不同，HCAI将伦理、参与性和情境敏感性原则嵌入土地利用治理体系。本文构建了包含技术整合、制度安排、利益相关方参与和土地利用创新四大支柱的分析框架，通过对九个代表不同洪涝类型、治理体制及AI/数字防洪韧性实践案例的城市进行文献比较分析加以验证。文献证据表明，机器学习、深度学习、图神经网络等AI工具在洪涝风险应用中可支持风险预测与响应协调，但其规划相关性取决于包容性决策与再生性土地利用策略。在适应性监管体系与参与式平台中实现AI或数字工具制度化嵌入的城市（如鹿特丹、哥本哈根、曼谷），展现出更清晰的规划政策路径；而依赖碎片化或项目式部署的城市（如威尼斯、悉尼）则呈现有限连续性。研究结果表明，单纯技术能力不足：规划相关性取决于治理成熟度、伦理保障、公民合法性及与空间规划工具的衔接。通过将算法智能与参与式及监管创新相结合，本研究提出了将HCAI嵌入空间治理的政策导向框架，并识别出可能推动从防御性洪涝控制向再生性、社会公正城市主义转型的条件。该框架为土地利用系统中的AI制度化提供指引，并推动关于公平、数据驱动气候适应的学术讨论。

title: From abandoned farmland to afforestation: Legal and spatial perspectives on land consolidation in Serbia
title_zh: 从废弃农田到造林：塞尔维亚土地整治的法律与空间视角
title_primary: 从废弃农田到造林：塞尔维亚土地整治的法律与空间视角
title_secondary: From abandoned farmland to afforestation: Legal and spatial perspectives on land consolidation in Serbia
authors: Sofija Nikolić Popadić, Ivan Potić
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The growing impact of climate change in Serbia underscores the urgent need to identify candidate areas where afforestation may be considered as a key adaptation and mitigation measure. This study applies a combined geospatial–legal approach to examine whether agricultural land consolidation can enable afforestation on abandoned farmland, while recognising that final suitability depends on site-specific ecological, socio-economic, and legal conditions. The geospatial component employs a multi-step methodology that integrates the Corine Land Cover (CLC) 2012–2018 and CLC+ Backbone 2018–2023 datasets, complemented by OpenStreetMap, Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) elevation data, and Google Earth imagery. It detects transitions from agricultural land to natural vegetation, filters them based on polygon size, elevation, and distance from settlements, and visually validates the shortlisted candidates. These candidate areas are treated as a screening output rather than as automatic afforestation sites, since abandoned agricultural land may also provide alternative ecosystem-service values, such as biodiversity-rich meadows, low-intensity grazing areas, or naturally regenerating habitats. Imagery-based validation shows that the longer-term CLC stream provides a more reliable basis for identifying abandonment–naturalisation candidates, while the higher-resolution CLC+ stream requires stricter verification. Four final case studies were selected: one from the CLC dataset and three from the CLC+ dataset, located in Rovine (Ivanjica municipality, western Serbia), Srednji Statovac and Donji Statovac (Prokuplje municipality, southern Serbia), and the cadastral municipalities of Gornja Bukovica and Leović (Ljubovija municipality, western Serbia). These examples highlight the fragmented cadastral structure and implementation challenges that characterise mountainous and peripheral rural landscapes. The legal component applies a doctrinal analysis of the Serbian legal framework governing agricultural land consolidation. The results show that, although current legislation allows consolidation for technical, organisational, and anti-erosion purposes, it does not explicitly recognise climate change mitigation and adaptation measures such as afforestation. The combined analysis suggests that recognising climate change measures as an explicit rationale for land consolidation would enable fit-for-purpose consolidation and align spatial opportunities with policy needs. The proposed methodology, therefore, serves both as a diagnostic tool for screening candidate areas and as a strategic decision-support framework for linking geospatial evidence with legal instruments, while allowing afforestation to be assessed against alternative land-use and ecosystem-service pathways.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对塞尔维亚日益加剧的影响，凸显了亟需识别可作为造林重点适应与减缓措施的关键区域。本研究采用地理空间与法律相结合的方法，探讨农业土地整合能否促进废弃农田上的造林活动，同时认识到最终适宜性取决于特定地点的生态、社会经济及法律条件。地理空间部分采用多步骤方法论，整合了Corine土地覆盖（CLC）2012-2018及CLC+ Backbone 2018-2023数据集，辅以OpenStreetMap、航天飞机雷达地形任务（SRTM）高程数据和谷歌地球影像。该方法检测从农业用地向自然植被的转变，基于地块大小、海拔及距居民点距离进行筛选，并对入围候选区域进行视觉验证。这些候选区域被视为筛选产出，而非自动造林地点，因为废弃农业用地也可能提供替代性生态系统服务价值，如生物多样性丰富的草甸、低强度放牧区或自然再生栖息地。基于影像的验证表明，长期CLC数据流为识别废弃-自然化候选区域提供了更可靠的基础，而更高分辨率的CLC+数据流则需要更严格的验证。最终选取了四个案例研究：一个来自CLC数据集，三个来自CLC+数据集，分别位于罗维内（伊万尼察市，塞尔维亚西部）、斯雷德尼·斯塔托瓦茨和多尼·斯塔托瓦茨（普罗库普列市，塞尔维亚南部），以及戈尔尼亚·布科维察和莱奥维奇（柳博维亚市，塞尔维亚西部）的地籍市镇。这些案例凸显了山区和边缘农村景观中地块结构碎片化及实施挑战。法律部分采用对塞尔维亚农业土地整合法律框架的教义分析。结果表明，尽管现行立法允许出于技术、组织和防侵蚀目的进行土地整合，但并未明确承认气候变化减缓与适应措施（如造林）。综合分析表明，将气候变化措施明确认定为土地整合的合理依据，将有助于实现针对性整合，并使空间机遇与政策需求相协调。因此，所提出的方法论既可作为筛选候选区域的诊断工具，也可作为将地理空间证据与法律工具相衔接的战略决策支持框架，同时允许造林与替代性土地利用和生态系统服务路径进行对比评估。

abstract: Degrowth is often advocated as a response to the climate crisis, but its consistency with growth theory remains unclear. We develop an endogenous growth model of directed technical change and climate in which the economy relies on both a polluting fossil resource and a clean renewable alternative. We fully characterize the social optimum and show that accounting for climate damages may justify an initial phase of degrowth. Such a phase is more likely when fossil resources are abundant and fossil-oriented research is relatively inefficient. In all cases, long-run optimal growth remains positive.

abstract: This study examines the impact of academic freedom reform on university graduates’ creativity using a large, multi-decade, cross-country sample. We construct a novel creativity index based on occupational task data and analyze how reforms in an individual’s home country affect their creativity after immigrating to the United States. Exploiting variation in reform timing across countries, we find that academic freedom reform significantly enhances graduates’ labor market creativity. Results are robust to multiple DID estimators, alternative specifications, placebo tests, and IV methods, as well as approaches addressing potential biases. Effects are particularly pronounced for developing countries, environments with decentralized governance, and low corruption. Reforms appear to boost creativity by encouraging higher educational attainment, facilitating entry into high-tech and research-oriented fields, and promoting managerial and professional roles. Our findings underscore the economic value of academic freedom and its potential as a policy instrument for nurturing student creativity.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用一个大规模、跨数十年、跨国别的样本，探讨学术自由改革对大学毕业生创造力的影响。我们基于职业任务数据构建了一个新颖的创造力指数，并分析个体母国的改革如何影响其移民美国后的创造力。利用各国改革时点的差异，我们发现学术自由改革显著提升了毕业生在劳动力市场中的创造力。这一结果在多种双重差分估计量、替代规格、安慰剂检验及工具变量方法中均保持稳健，同时亦考虑了可能偏差的处理方法。效应在发展中国家、治理结构分散及腐败程度低的环境中尤为显著。改革似乎通过鼓励更高层次的教育成就、促进进入高科技及研究导向领域，以及推动管理及专业角色的担任来增强创造力。我们的发现强调了学术自由的经济价值及其作为培育学生创造力的政策工具的潜力。

abstract: This paper examines whether mobile money reduces gender gaps in financial autonomy across six Sahelian countries using Afrobarometer Round 9 data (2021-2023, N=6, 540). Instrumenting adoption with distance to traditional financial services, we find pronounced heterogeneity: mobile money increases women's autonomy by 11 percentage points in Senegal (26% gap reduction) and 16 points in Sudan (38% reduction), with no detectable effects in four other countries. This variation correlates with ecosystem maturity, agent density, and regulatory quality. Mechanisms include transactional discretion, informal credit access, and enhanced security. Transformative impacts require 10-14 years ecosystem maturation and agent density above 1 per 2, 000 inhabitants. Digital finance advances women's empowerment only under specific institutional conditions.

authors: Zachary Ward
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: During the Age of Mass Migration, over forty percent of immigrants were women, yet most research focuses on men. Using linked 1900 and 1910 Census records, I show that economic assimilation patterns differed for men and women, and families assimilated at different rates than individuals. Immigrant families improved their relative income scores compared with US-born families, driven by reliance on multiple earners, particularly women’s and children’s labor. At the individual level, gaps between immigrant and US-born income scores were larger for women than men, and the gap for women barely changed even after twenty years of stay.
abstract_zh: 在大规模移民时代，超过40%的移民为女性，但多数研究聚焦于男性。通过关联1900年和1910年的人口普查记录，我发现男性和女性的经济同化模式存在差异，且家庭层面的同化速度与个体层面不同。移民家庭相较于本土出生家庭，其相对收入得分有所提升，这主要得益于对多重收入来源的依赖，尤其是女性和儿童的劳动。在个体层面，移民与本土出生者收入得分的差距在女性中比男性更大，且即使居住二十年后，女性的这一差距也几乎没有变化。

abstract: This paper shows that expected capital gains in several MSAs were higher for relatively lower-priced, rather than higher-priced, houses during the U.S. boom of the 2000s. Because buyers of lower-priced houses tend to be more sensitive to credit conditions than buyers of higher-priced houses, this paper documents patterns that are consistent with an interaction of beliefs and credit conditions in a time period where direct evidence on house price beliefs is scarce. Documenting this interaction is important for unifying beliefs and credit conditions as joint, instead of competing, explanations for the U.S. housing boom of the 2000s.

title: Manager Pay Inequality and Market Power
title_zh: 经理薪酬不平等与市场势力
title_primary: 经理薪酬不平等与市场势力
title_secondary: Manager Pay Inequality and Market Power
authors: Renjie Bao, Jan De Loecker, Jan Eeckhout
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Manager pay has increased considerably since 1980, and so has inequality in manager pay. Over the same period, there has been a sharp rise in market power. We start from the premise that the role of managers is to increase firm productivity. When markets are imperfectly competitive, productivity not only helps firm grow in size, productivity also affects market power. We model how imperfect competition in product markets affects manager pay, and break down the contributions of firm size and market power to compensation. We find that market power, on average, accounts for 45.2% of total manager pay. Notably, there is substantial variation across managers. Top managers are disproportionately employed by firms with market power, and they benefit from it: in 2019, 80.3% of top manager pay is attributable to market power. Our main conclusion is that rise of market power explains half of the increase in average manager pay, and nearly all of the increase in manager pay inequality.
abstract_zh: 自1980年以来，管理者薪酬大幅增长，管理者薪酬不平等程度也随之加剧。同期，市场势力急剧上升。我们基于管理者职责在于提升企业生产率这一前提展开研究。当市场处于不完全竞争状态时，生产率不仅有助于企业规模扩张，还会影响市场势力。我们构建模型分析产品市场不完全竞争对管理者薪酬的影响机制，并分解企业规模与市场势力对薪酬的贡献度。研究发现，市场势力平均占管理者总薪酬的45.2%。值得注意的是，不同管理者之间存在显著差异。高层管理者不成比例地受雇于具有市场势力的企业，并从中获益：2019年，高层管理者薪酬的80.3%可归因于市场势力。我们的主要结论是：市场势力的上升解释了平均管理者薪酬增长的一半，以及管理者薪酬不平等加剧的几乎全部原因。

abstract: This paper studies the effects of extreme temperatures on labor supply and performance in the heavy-duty trucking industry, a pivotal sector with broad productivity spillovers and significant road safety externalities. Using rich and high-frequency data on individual truck drivers in China, we find that exposure to extreme heat significantly reduces labor supply and increases the incidence of risky driving. Evidence further suggests that extreme temperatures disrupt off-duty rest and increase on-duty fatigue among drivers. We also document behavioral adaptation: drivers respond to heat by adjusting work schedules and reallocating labor to adjacent days. Furthermore, the estimated temperature effects on labor supply and risky driving are smaller among drivers employed by firms that offer heat subsidies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了极端温度对重型卡车运输行业劳动力供给与工作表现的影响，该行业具有广泛的生产率溢出效应和显著的道路安全外部性。利用中国个体卡车司机丰富的高频数据，我们发现暴露于极端高温显著降低了劳动力供给，并增加了危险驾驶行为的发生率。进一步证据表明，极端温度扰乱了司机的下班休息，并加剧了上班期间的疲劳。我们还记录了行为适应现象：司机通过调整工作安排并将劳动重新分配至邻近日期来应对高温。此外，在提供高温补贴的企业所雇用的司机中，温度对劳动力供给和危险驾驶的估计影响较小。

title: The Rule of Law Predicts Trust in Journalists

official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Insufficient trust in journalists creates space for disinformation. We ask whether institutions can safeguard trust in journalists. Our main finding is that the rule of law is positively and robustly associated with trust in journalists. The rule of law arguably promotes trustworthy behavior by punishing deceit and dishonesty, thereby fostering trust. Robustness checks support this result. Moderation analysis indicates that the relationship between the rule of law and trust in journalists is weaker in low-income countries; this difference vanishes once gross domestic product per capita, a variable strongly correlated with the rule of lawyer negatively associated with trust in journalists, is taken into account. A heterogeneous treatment analysis using the COVID-19 pandemic as an exogenous shock to trust levels offers suggestive evidence against reverse causality. Though exploratory, our findings point to the importance of high-quality legal institutions in combatting distrust in journalists.
abstract_zh: 对记者的信任不足为虚假信息提供了空间。我们探究制度能否维护对记者的信任。主要发现是，法治水平与对记者的信任呈稳健的正相关关系。法治通过惩罚欺骗与不诚实行为，促进可信赖行为，从而培育信任。稳健性检验支持这一结果。调节效应分析表明，在低收入国家，法治与记者信任之间的关联较弱；一旦考虑人均国内生产总值（这一与法治高度相关且与记者信任呈负相关的变量），该差异便消失。利用新冠疫情作为信任水平的外生冲击进行的异质性处理分析，提供了反向因果关系的提示性证据。尽管本研究属于探索性分析，但研究结果凸显了高质量法律制度在对抗对记者不信任中的重要性。

official: 官方在线 2025-10-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Driven by dual-carbon goals, companies are moving towards green and sustainable development models. Therefore, environmental, social and governance (ESG) benchmark has become a key focus of corporations. Employing data from 1988 Chinese listed manufacturing firms between 2018 and 2023, this study uses quantile regression to explore how ESG performance, as disclosed by companies across different value segments, impacts corporate value through specific mechanisms. This study has several key findings. First, it shows that environmental and social performance drive growth in low- and medium-value enterprises. By comparison, the positive effect of the governance dimension extends across all value segments, and this effect strengthens as the enterprise value increases. Second, the mechanism analysis indicates a pathway through which ESG enhances corporate value. This is because ESG performance attracts external investment, which enhances corporate green innovation capabilities. Third, the heterogeneity analysis indicates a stronger ESG impact on specific company types. Non-state-owned enterprises and heavily polluting firms experience significant effects. For these companies, the benefits are primarily derived from the social and governance dimensions. This study clarifies how the three ESG dimensions affect firms across various value segments. It also offers practical insights that enable companies to leverage ESG to achieve sustainable development.

title: Why providing more information to parents may not always improve child educational outcomes: lessons from a study in China

authors: Keyu Chen, Yizhi Wang
official: 官方在线 2025-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Information asymmetries between parents and children, as well as poor school-parent communication, hinder parental participation in education. This paper examines two key questions: (1) How does reducing information asymmetries affect student performance? (2) What drives changes in parental and student behaviour? Using data from a Shenzhen school, nearly 250 parents received both positive and negative information on their children’s school performance. The experiment, conducted over two semesters starting in spring 2019, was terminated in spring 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Contrary to expectations and existing literature, increased parental information was correlated with lower test scores. The explanation lies in ‘upward belief bias’, where parents overestimate their children’s behaviour. Although school information corrected these beliefs, negatively surprised parents responded with increased involvement, such as punishments or rewards for money and playtime, which proved counterproductive. The findings suggest that excessive parental intervention, particularly in response to negative information, exerts undue pressure on children, harming their academic performance. Over-incentivization may not be beneficial for elementary students in China, highlighting the need for balanced parental involvement.
abstract_zh: 家长与子女之间的信息不对称，以及学校与家长之间沟通不畅，阻碍了家长参与教育。本文探讨两个关键问题：（1）减少信息不对称如何影响学生表现？（2）是什么驱动了家长和学生行为的改变？利用深圳一所学校的数据，近250名家长收到了关于其子女在校表现的正面和负面信息。该实验自2019年春季开始，持续两个学期，因COVID-19疫情于2020年春季终止。与预期及现有文献相反，家长获得更多信息与考试成绩下降相关。其原因在于“向上信念偏差”，即家长高估子女的行为表现。尽管学校信息纠正了这些信念，但受到负面惊讶的家长以增加参与度作为回应，如采取惩罚或对金钱和游戏时间进行奖惩，结果适得其反。研究结果表明，过度的家长干预，尤其是针对负面信息的干预，给孩子施加了不当压力，损害了其学业表现。过度激励可能对中国小学生并无益处，凸显了平衡家长参与的必要性。

abstract: We find consistent evidence across ratings and regions that delta-hedged credit index options have large negative Sharpe ratios and much more so than their equity index counterparts. Risk-factors extracted from equity index options have only moderate explanatory power for the time-series and cross-sectional variation in credit option returns, while a single credit-specific factor explains much of the remaining variation. We link this factor to credit option order flow in a manner that is consistent with the predictions of a demand-based option pricing model, where order-flow risk is priced in equilibrium.

Discusses an introduction to the economics of infectious disease; choosing the first-line drug for malaria treatment--how cost-effectiveness analysis can inform policy; economic issues related to antimicrobial resistance; economic evaluation of HIV prevention activities--dynamic challenges for cost-effectiveness analysis; modeling the cost-effectiveness of the new interventions--how technological change can be incorporated; complexity and the attribution of cost to hospital-acquired infection (HAI); decision analysis of strategies to deal with noncompliance with tuberculosis treatment; the economic evaluation of HAI; the socioeconomic burden of influenza--costs of illness and “willingness to pay” in a publicly funded health care system; willingness to pay for insecticide-treated mosquito nets in Surat, India; disentangling value--assessing the benefits of containing antimicrobial resistance; economics of animal health--implications for public health; risk assessment models, economic analysis, and food safety policy; transaction cost economics and principal-agent theory--insights into investigations of outbreaks of infectious diseases; governance arrangements for the control of infectious disease; evaluating U.S. food safety regulations which use benefit and cost information; global governance of international public health--the role of international regulatory cooperation; trade and infectious disease outbreaks--ensuring public health… Index.”
